why: A = the three listed theorems at universe 0 (π_eq_π_iff_exists_smul, isOpenEmbedding_orbitQuotientMap, range_orbitQuotientMap); proposition_7_1_19, proposition_7_1_19_fullyFaithful, proposition_7_1_19_orbitMap, translationOrbitHomeomorph and orbitQuotientMap are data definitions (proposition_7_1_19 is assembled from the two orbitQuotientMap theorems) and are not in A. A is for R : NaturalRep (U connected); B is for every natural action with U merely open, and B includes that the obvious functor preserves units and composition, which fails for disconnected U: the V7_22 witness (trivialZ3EpGroupoid, U = {y<1} ∪ {y>1}, Γ twisted by c ≠ 1 on {y>1}) gives Γ(1,2) ≠ 1_2, so B is false (not_B) and A → B is false. B's homeomorphism and fully-faithful claims themselves hold for disconnected U too. B → A: from B's homeomorphism τ with τ[y] = |y| (injectivity, and the orbit relation is an equivalence) one gets π_eq_π_iff_exists_smul; isOpenEmbedding_orbitQuotientMap then follows from injectivity, continuity of the quotient lift and openness of π (Proposition 7.1); the range statement is immediate.
B_issue: B's IsNatAction omits connectedness of U(x) (Theorem 7.1's U is connected in the project), and B also asserts functoriality of (g,y) ↦ Γ(g,y); together these make B false. With 'U connected' added B would be true. The homeomorphism part of B is fine.
